epic.summary: Upgrade charge-controller firmware from Zephyr v3.2 to v4.3

tickets.title: Foundation: Zephyr v4.3 workspace, Kconfig, test harness, reference board
acceptance: west.yml tracks zephyrproject-rtos v4.3-branch; `make test` runs on native_sim
All existing unit tests pass on Zephyr v4.3 (none removed, none skipped)
Reference board mppt_2420_lc builds under hardware model v2 inside the flash budget
Board and devicetree roots are declared in zephyr/module.yml
tickets.description:
## Scope
Wave 0 of the Zephyr v3.2 -> v4.3 upgrade. Base branch: `upgrade/zephyr-4.3`.

## Owned paths
- `west.yml`
- `zephyr/**`
- `app/CMakeLists.txt`
- `app/prj.conf`
- `app/Kconfig`
- `tests/**`
- `boards/*/mppt_2420_lc/**`
- `dts/**`
- `scripts/**`
- `.github/**`

## Findings (3)
- KCFG-003: Newlib selected explicitly (picolibc is the default C library) (3)

## Acceptance criteria
- west.yml tracks zephyrproject-rtos v4.3-branch; `make test` runs on native_sim
- All existing unit tests pass on Zephyr v4.3 (none removed, none skipped)
- Reference board mppt_2420_lc builds under hardware model v2 inside the flash budget
- Board and devicetree roots are declared in zephyr/module.yml

## Gate
`python3 tools/migrate/gate.py --ticket foundation --boards mppt_2420_lc`

No new compiler warnings in application code
tickets.description:
## Scope

## Owned paths
- `app/src/*.cpp`
- `app/src/*.c`
- `app/src/*.h`
- `tests/src/tests_numerics*`

## Findings (7)

## Acceptance criteria
